title: Biggest Serie A seasons
brief: Name the ten players with the most Serie A goals in a single season since 2000/01. Each player counts once, for his best season.

notes.Francesco Totti: Francesco Totti's best is 26 goals (2006/07), just outside the top ten.
notes.Hernan Crespo: Hernan Crespo's best is 26 goals (2000/01), just outside the top ten.
notes.Fabio Quagliarella: Fabio Quagliarella's best is 26 goals (2018/19), just outside the top ten.
notes.Andrea Belotti: Andrea Belotti's best is 26 goals (2016/17), just outside the top ten.
notes.Victor Osimhen: Victor Osimhen's best is 26 goals (2022/23), just outside the top ten.

checks: Each player-season summed by Transfermarkt player id across clubs (none of these ten moved mid-season), re-added from the player's Transfermarkt game log and checked against his Wikipedia career table; top-scorer seasons also match the game's own seriea-ts boards and the Capocannoniere list.
